Answer: C
Reason: The initial CT (Figure 1a) shows bilateral peribronchial consolidations and nodular opacities characteristic of cryptogenic organizing pneumonia (COP). The follow-up CT (Figure 2a) demonstrates a significant reduction in these consolidations with residual ground-glass opacities, which is the typical radiological response to corticosteroid treatment in COP.
